terms.attribution: Fonte: IBGE, API de Malhas Geográficas, referência 2022, qualidade máxima. Derivados calculados pelo Mapa Estratégico.

crs: Input/output WGS84 longitude/latitude; source API coordinates derived from SIRGAS 2000, no precision beyond source asserted.

centroid.method: Per-municipality spherical Lambert azimuthal equal-area, authalic radius 6371007.1809 m, projection origin bounding-box centre; signed shoelace areas by ring role; islands weighted by area, holes subtracted; inverse projection.
centroid.input: Entire downloaded maximum-quality geometry BEFORE local simplification. IBGE API itself provides simplified meshes, not the original shapefile.
centroid.accuracy: Numerical convergence only; source positional accuracy and projection-dependent centroid definition are not a survey-accuracy guarantee.

outline.method: Douglas-Peucker in fixed equirectangular metric projection, spherical length scale bound 1/cos(15 deg); all source vertices checked after rounding. Polygon/MultiPolygon, holes and islands retained.
outline.topology: All 27 UFs checked for ring self-intersections after simplification and rounding; each invalid candidate retries at half tolerance (up to 12 attempts), then preserves the original valid ring without rounding. Invalid source rings cannot be used as fallback: absence of a simple candidate fails generation. The downloaded Amazonas source has pre-existing crossings; its emitted simplified ring passes the same check. Rings simplified independently; not a shared-edge topological dataset; unsuitable for administrative/legal boundary decisions.
outline.brazil: Union visually represented by the collection of 27 real UF polygons, including islands. No fabricated bounding polygon.
